status.pretraining: Full-official original RGBNT100 DeMo50 bestE8 plus additional50/new Adam; original identity encoder fixed

anchor.method: AL RGBNT100 joint-logit Softmax temperature2 versus frozen AG temperature1. All joint a_S+c_b+psi logits divided by2; no uniform-mixture floor, additional expert, head, loss, parameter, descriptor dimension or backbone adaptation. Same original DeMo50 teacher42/freshheads42/newAdam/additional50, hardP8K8/B64, mainCE.25/hinge.6/reg.05/MFaux.001/cap.10/BN2/partial0/two backwards/5120. Both ordinary mixed-source and structured dual-axis controls use temperature2. Current AG/AK selected routes concentrate on low bands; this is a testable routing hypothesis, not proof that high-band information is absent or temperature improves retrieval. Fresh native3 percontrol checks gradients/reload and routing-only FP32 T1 parity/no-psi factorization before formal50; highest normal benchmarkmAP/earliesttie/all6sameweight. Only2026physicalGPU2/3/max2/onepercard; preserveK201/strongMS; no201NN/missing专项/49/seedhunt.
anchor.limits: Common context remains auxiliary; coupled gate is not claimed calibrated. Twelve disjoint-source cases lack shared identity coordinates; missing evaluation deferred.

final_unit_descriptor_bound.placement: After complete parent M/F/I aggregation, gates and relation weights; before final deployed return
final_unit_descriptor_bound.inactive_output: Exact original candidate bytes; 00 remains the existing frozen identity path
final_unit_descriptor_bound.limits: Known norm bound; not retrieval correctness or guaranteed +1. K PI10/01 native equality is checked before this new output bound.

anchor.contribution_reference: Stopped-gradient corresponding gallery state; fixed00 positive/negative indices

M_F_auxiliary_outlet.current: Actual first11 projected per-relation unit directions, existing-score relation pool512
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.auxiliary_dtype: FP32 deployed directions; previous raw pools under native AMP
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.metric_outlet: AG softTriplet on actual first11 per512 units flattened+whole-normalized3584; scored512 CE unchanged
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.pooling_domain: Existing M/F pool_score reused over seven projected relation directions, previously raw bands/source-band evidence; no new score parameters/calls
M_F_auxiliary_outlet.inference: Hooks/pool replacement inactive in eval; original5120 graph

F_auxiliary_scorer_precision.scope: Actual second projected F relation scoring only
F_auxiliary_scorer_precision.unchanged_calls: All 4D independent/raw/controlled01 scoring uses the original method
F_auxiliary_scorer_precision.evidence: W ordinary native3 nnz0/3/0 versus sameZ/weight/scaledfull upstream FP32 localVJP512/512/512; original native failure retained, new pair native required

M_auxiliary_scorer_precision.scope: Actual second projected M relation scoring only
M_auxiliary_scorer_precision.unchanged_calls: All 4D independent/raw/controlled10 scoring uses the original method
M_auxiliary_scorer_precision.evidence: Source-reviewed AC ordinary replay measured three actual updates: steps1/3 Mscore grad present finite allzero, step2 nonzero53; same actual Z/weight/upstream local FP32 VJP nonzero512. Gradients remain extremely small; supports precision sensitivity, not a proved individual underflow instruction or retrieval gain. Candidate numerical repair needs fresh matched random/hard native3 pervariant; no gate relaxation.

anchor.routing_change: All existing joint a_S+c_b+psi logits divided by2 before legal-relation masking and softmax. All other routing, conditioning, projections, gates, losses and frozen encoder behavior retain AG.

status.checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
status.evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
status.selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
status.method_revision: AL RGBNT100 joint-logit Softmax temperature2 versus frozen AG temperature1. All joint a_S+c_b+psi logits divided by2; no uniform-mixture floor, additional expert, head, loss, parameter, descriptor dimension or backbone adaptation. Same original DeMo50 teacher42/freshheads42/newAdam/additional50, hardP8K8/B64, mainCE.25/hinge.6/reg.05/MFaux.001/cap.10/BN2/partial0/two backwards/5120. Both ordinary mixed-source and structured dual-axis controls use temperature2. Current AG/AK selected routes concentrate on low bands; this is a testable routing hypothesis, not proof that high-band information is absent or temperature improves retrieval. Fresh native3 percontrol checks gradients/reload and routing-only FP32 T1 parity/no-psi factorization before formal50; highest normal benchmarkmAP/earliesttie/all6sameweight. Only2026physicalGPU2/3/max2/onepercard; preserveK201/strongMS; no201NN/missing专项/49/seedhunt.
status.partial_training: AG hard record/augmentation/partial sequence, BN2/partial0/two backwards retained; only joint-logit temperature2. Existing independent10/01 paths remain unchanged.
status.amp_policy: Native fp16 GradScaler512; actual optimizer updates and skipped steps recorded
